line: Fuckin’ on her five years (yeah) On God I ain’t never kissed her (on God)
meaning: In this line, he says that he has been having sexual engagements with this girl for five years, but he has never kissed her.

line: Nigga tryna rob me (21) You gon’ need the whole hood with me (on God)
meaning: 21 Savage is stating here that if you are going to try and rob him, you are going to need to bring the whole “hood”, as in all your people, with you. Most likely because he always has his goons with him.
